value.rationale: The result answers a natural compatibility question between the two main refinements developed in the source: arithmetic restrictions on denominators and arbitrary redistribution of the logarithmic saving. The unit-congruence index \(I_m\) becomes a transparent quantitative cost in the saving budget, and \(I_m\le m^4\) yields an explicit usable corollary. This is more than a parameter substitution because the witnesses supplied by the two published theorems need not coincide; the proof must re-run the shaped Minkowski body on the congruence sublattice.
